articles.title: Spot HYPE ETFs absorb 1% of market cap in first 10 trading days: Kairos
articles.snippet: Spot HYPE ETFs absorbed 1.04% of Hyperliquid’s market cap in 10 trading days, beating Bitcoin and Ether ETF debuts.

articles.title: Some Non-Enhanced Athletes Beat Their Juiced Rivals at the 'Steroid Olympics'
